(i) mushrooms collected from the highlands in the subalpine regions of the Minya-Konka and Yunnan were contaminated with 137Cs; (ii) the contamination of mushrooms with 137Cs was dependent on climate conditions; and (iii) 137Cs activity concentration in mushrooms was much lower than the activity concentration of natural 40K.
